description: TY2026: SS 179 with the phase-out binding (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 SS 3.24). Elected cost $4,200,000 exceeds the $4,090,000 threshold by $110,000 -> cap 2,560,000 - 110,000 = 2,450,000; income base (6,000,000 - 1,000,000 = 5,000,000) does not bind -> deduction $2,450,000. TI = 5,000,000 - 2,450,000 = 2,550,000 -> 21% = $535,500.00. No income-limit carryforward (the phase-out excess does not carry).
